D: A charming Englishman keeps running into the same American woman at a run of weddings.
P: Serve the snacks when the guests pour into the first wedding reception.
S: Smoked salmon blinis, and asparagus spears wrapped in crisp prosciutto

Blinis topped with crème fraîche, smoked salmon and dill, beside asparagus spears wrapped in prosciutto and grilled. Top 16 blinis with crème fraîche, smoked salmon and dill. Blanch a bunch of asparagus for a minute, wrap each spear in prosciutto and grill until crisp. Arrange both on trays for the first of several weddings.
aged cheddar, thick ham, pickled onions, mustard-salted eggs and chutney with crusty bread and apple

Aged cheddar, thick-cut ham, sharp pickled onions, a jammy egg with mustard salt and tomato chutney, with crusty bread, cold butter and apple. Boil 4 eggs for 7 minutes, cool in iced water, peel, halve and sprinkle with salt mixed with a pinch of mustard powder. Cut 250g aged cheddar into thick wedges and fold 200g thick-cut ham onto a big board. Add 8 pickled onions, a bowl of tomato chutney, 1 sliced green apple tossed in lemon, a handful of watercress and the eggs. Slice a crusty loaf thickly and serve with a block of cold butter.
Oatcakes with goat's cheese, roast beetroot, thyme and honey

Oatcakes spread with soft goat's cheese, topped with roast beetroot, thyme and a drizzle of honey. Wrap 2 beetroot in foil and roast at 200C for 50 minutes, then cool, peel and slice thin. Spread oatcakes with goat's cheese. Top with beetroot, a few thyme leaves and a drizzle of honey and lay them out on a slate for a castle wedding in the Highlands.
M: Highland braised lamb, neeps and tatties
shoulder braised with barley, carrots and rosemary, mashed swede and spuds

Lamb shoulder braised 3 hours with onion, carrots and barley, with mashed neeps and tatties. Season 1.5kg lamb shoulder and brown all over in a heavy pot. Add 2 chopped onions, 3 carrots in chunks, 75g pearl barley, rosemary and 750ml chicken stock. Cover and braise at 160C for 3 hours until it pulls apart. Boil 800g peeled potatoes and 600g swede separately until soft. Mash the potatoes with 50g butter and a splash of milk and the swede with 30g butter and pepper. Serve the lamb and barley over both with the juices.
Beef topside, Yorkshire puddings baked in muffin tins, roast potatoes
Beef topside roasted at 200C to medium, rested, with Yorkshire puddings, roast potatoes and gravy made from the pan juices.
W: Lemon sponge layers filled with lemon curd and whipped cream

Two lemon butter sponges filled with lemon curd and whipped cream, iced white and finished with fresh flowers like a country wedding. Beat 250g butter with 250g sugar, add 4 eggs and lemon zest, then fold in 250g self-raising flour. Bake in 2 tins at 175C for 30 minutes. Fill with lemon curd and whipped cream, ice white and decorate with fresh flowers.
K: Elderflower cordial and lemon in a flute with a cucumber ribbon, topped with bubbles

Elderflower cordial and lemon over cucumber ribbons, topped with cold sparkling wine. Peel 1 Lebanese cucumber into long ribbons and curl one into each of 4 flutes or wine glasses. Add 20ml elderflower cordial and a squeeze of lemon to each. Top slowly with cold sparkling wine from a 750ml bottle. For drivers, use sparkling water and a little extra cordial.

steps.text: Trim the asparagus, blanch for a minute and drain.
Shave the eggplant lengthways into thin strips with a peeler and brush with the oil and paprika.
Wrap each spear in a strip of eggplant and grill until crisp.
Slice the beetroot very thin and dress with lemon juice.
Top the blinis with crème fraîche, beetroot and dill.

dishes.make_ahead: Make the batter up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; roast the beef and bake the puddings on the day

steps.text: Season the beef. Whisk the flour, eggs and milk into a batter and rest it.
Roast the beef at 200C to medium.
Peel and chop the potatoes, toss them in some of the vegetable oil and put them in alongside.
Rest the beef. Heat the muffin tins with the rest of the vegetable oil.
Pour in the batter and bake.
Make gravy from the pan juices and stock.

veg.make_ahead: Shape the nut roast up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

ingredients.item: plain flour, 150g for the batter and 20g for the gravy
eggs, 3 for the batter and 2 for the roast

steps.text: Whisk 150 g of the flour, 3 eggs and the milk into a batter and rest it.
Fry the onion and mushrooms in 1 tbsp of the oil until dry, then mix with the lentils, nuts, breadcrumbs, 2 eggs, cheddar, thyme and 1 tbsp of the soy sauce. Press into a lined loaf tin.
Roast the nut roast at 200C for 45 minutes until firm and browned.
Peel and chop the potatoes and roast them in 2 tbsp of the oil alongside.
Rest the nut roast. Heat the rest of the oil in muffin tins.
Pour in the batter and bake.
Melt the butter, stir in the rest of the flour, whisk in the stock and the rest of the soy sauce and simmer for gravy.
Heat the oven to 175C and prepare two tins. Beat the butter and sugar, add the eggs and lemon zest, then fold in the flour.
Bake in two tins.
Cool completely.
Whip the cream and sandwich with lemon curd and cream.
Ice white with icing sugar and water and decorate with flowers.
